questions.text: Texas was part of which country BEFORE it became an independent republic?
questions.answer: Mexico

questions.text: The Battle of the Alamo in 1836 was significant because ___
options: it was the first battle of World War I
Texans fought for independence from Mexico
Mexico won its independence from Spain
it began the Texas oil boom
questions.answer: Texans fought for independence from Mexico

questions.text: Who was the commander of the Texas forces at the Battle of San Jacinto where Texas won its independence?
questions.answer: Sam Houston

questions.text: Stephen F. Austin is called the 'Father of Texas' because he ___
options: led settlers to establish colonies in Texas
was the first President of Texas
questions.answer: led settlers to establish colonies in Texas

questions.text: Texas became the ___ state to join the United States.
questions.answer: 28th

questions.text: A PRIMARY SOURCE is ___
options: an original document or artifact from the time period being studied
questions.answer: an original document or artifact from the time period being studied

questions.text: Which of these is an example of a PRIMARY SOURCE from the Texas Revolution?
options: A modern textbook about Texas history
A letter written by Sam Houston in 1836
questions.answer: A letter written by Sam Houston in 1836

questions.text: SUPPLY and DEMAND: When a product is SCARCE (hard to find) and many people want it, the price usually ___
questions.answer: goes up

questions.text: INTERDEPENDENCE means that communities and countries ___
options: compete and never help each other
depend on each other for goods and services
questions.answer: depend on each other for goods and services

questions.text: Texas has many different REGIONS. The region known for cattle ranching and wide open spaces is the ___
questions.answer: Great Plains

questions.text: The GULF COAST region of Texas is important because ___
options: it borders the Gulf of Mexico and supports fishing, shipping, and tourism
it is where most oil was discovered
it is the hottest and driest region
questions.answer: it borders the Gulf of Mexico and supports fishing, shipping, and tourism

questions.text: The three BRANCHES of the United States government are ___
questions.answer: Legislative, Executive, Judicial

questions.text: The LEGISLATIVE branch of government is responsible for ___
questions.answer: making the laws

questions.text: The CONSTITUTION is the most important law of the land because it ___
options: describes the daily schedule of the government
establishes the framework and basic laws of the government
questions.answer: establishes the framework and basic laws of the government

questions.text: Citizens have RIGHTS and RESPONSIBILITIES. Voting in elections is both a right AND a ___
questions.answer: responsibility of citizenship

questions.text: LATITUDE lines on a map run EAST and WEST and measure distance ___
options: north and south from the equator
questions.answer: north and south from the equator

questions.text: LONGITUDE lines on a map run NORTH and SOUTH and measure distance ___
options: north and south from the equator
east and west from the Prime Meridian
questions.answer: east and west from the Prime Meridian

questions.text: Which economic concept explains why a student might SAVE money over time to buy something expensive?
options: Saving for a future want or need
questions.answer: Saving for a future want or need

questions.text: The Texas ECONOMY is based on several important industries. Which is the LARGEST industry in Texas today?
questions.answer: Energy (oil and gas)

questions.text: The ALAMO is located in which Texas city?
questions.answer: San Antonio
